'''Mogroch''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|being]] alive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] owed Mogroch 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at one point, which he could not pay back in a timely fashion. Mogroch sent a [[Unidentified Muur|Muur]] after Garnet to intimidate him and give him an ultimatum of two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to pay the [[Currency/Legends|money]].<ref name="RPG" />
